hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '\[binary\.' 2>/dev/null; then echo 'BLOCK: binary sections are managed by CI - do not edit manually' >&2; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.toml ]]; then python3 -c "import tomllib, sys; tomllib.load(open(sys.argv[1],'rb'))" "$FILE" || { echo 'Invalid TOML syntax' >&2; exit 1; }; fi
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == recipes/*.toml ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *.binaries.toml ]]; then gale lint "$FILE" 2>&1 || exit 1; fi
